what: Clicking a same-site link: after .3s the current page rises 20vh over 1s (power2.inOut), and a dark overlay fades in over .8s up to 60% on top, then navigation happens. The incoming page covers from 100vh below, rising over 1s — the old page is pushed up and darkens while the new page covers it from below

options.rise: Duration of the incoming page covering upward (sec), default 1 — 0 means instant
options.from: Start position of the rising cover (vh), default 100
options.shade-at: When the curtain starts to cover (seconds, after the panel starts rising), default 0 — Brand .2
options.shade-ease: Curtain curve, default same as ease — Brand 0.25,0.46,0.45,0.9
options.look: fade: Opacity only, without raising a plate — when leaving it goes to 0 over out seconds after hold, and the page arrived at via a link goes 0 → 1 over rise seconds after in-delay (knot: hold .3 · out .6 · ease expo.inOut · rise .6 · in-ease power4.out · in-delay .1). No shade overlay is laid down
options.in-ease: Curve for the incoming page, default same as ease — knot power4.out
options.in-delay: Delay before the incoming page enters (sec), default 0 — knot .1
options.slow-hold: [data-fx-part="slow"] Wait (seconds) for inner links, same as the default hold — for links that must close first and then leave, like a menu drawer (knot drawer 1s)
options.[data-fx-part=slow]: (if present) links inside wait for slow-hold before navigating — menu drawer
options.self: /  If 1, links to the current page (logo etc.) also reopen with the same transition — knot. Skipped by default

from.where: shared.js bootBarba SF-transition — original barba 2.10.0: beforeLeave freezes the current page after .3s, overlay (.page-overlay) .6 .8s, page −20vh 1s, enter new page 100vh→0 1s (power2.inOut). Since this part is a transition that reloads the document, the old and new pages do not overlap but run leave → enter in sequence

shared.js transition to-detail (list → work detail — original taxi “to-single-work”: the previous page is pushed −33vh over 1.4s expo.inOut, after .2s a dark-ink overlay goes up to .8 over .4s, and the new page covers it from below over 1.4s expo.inOut)
from.options: hold: 0; out: 1.4; lift: 33; shade: .8; shade-dur: .4; shade-at: .2; shade-ease: 0.25,0.46,0.45,0.9; rise: 1.4; from: 100; ease: 0.87,0,0.13,1

from.where: shared.js #page transition — look: fade · hold .3 (drawer link 1) · out .6 expo.inOut · enters .1s later for .6s power4.out
shared.js barba sync handoff — hold: 0; out: 1.2; lift: 25; shade: .8; shade-dur: 1.2; rise: 1.2; ease: 0.7,0.05,0.13,1 (old and new sections move together)

shared.js leave · .p-slide (the next page’s color panel covers from below in 1.25s at 0.4,0,0,1 while the current page rises 25vh under a .6 shade — hold 0 · out 1.25 · lift 25 · shade .6 · ease 0.4,0,0,1, the switch happens when the panel is 75% across, and the new page does not rise, only the panel peels away)
shared.js leaveAnim·enterAnim (Barba sync — current page rises 25vh while the veil goes up to .8 in 1.2s, new page covers up from 100vh below in 1.2s, both 0.7,0.05,0.13,1)
from.options: hold: 0; out: 1.2; lift: 25; shade: .8; shade-dur: 1.2; rise: 1.2; ease: 0.7,0.05,0.13,1

from.where: Every page uses .ws-page (the original Transition module, same as knot: .3s after a link click, #page goes transparent over .6s Expo.easeInOut, links inside the drawer wait 1s, the incoming page starts .1s later and takes .6s Power4.easeOut).
from.options: look: fade; hold: .3; slow-hold: 1; out: .6; ease: expo.inOut; rise: .6; in-ease: power4.out; in-delay: .1; self: 1

note: The original overlaps two panels with barba so the new panel rises over the previous one. The part really navigates the page, so the new page rises after the previous panel has fully risen (curtain color is --kf-contrast-bg). On keyboard and back navigation (bfcache) the panel is returned to its place. With reduced motion it navigates immediately with no wait
